title: Day 3 of prototyping TEMU hawk aiwasteland
author: Affectionate_Fact854
selftext:
so day 1 i just spent completely delving into planning, finding skateboarding references , finding a (temporary 3d  puppet character)    and finding props real photos 

day 2 i spent having open code use topology rules , real photo reference for guides , and let it build each prop with blender directly,it also built the skateboard in blender while the other agent started working on the back bone physics logic in small steps 

day 3 now , just slapped the character on the board, gave it bare basic animations , and started working on the bowl and camera angling logic 

  
The graphics is also not detailed as im first building all the logic, behind physics , and edge cases before i test web export to see how much i can push into making this more ps3 era graphics 

BUT its a fun project!

replies.author: Affectionate_Fact854
replies.body:
I know right, but this will take easily 2weeks to just build the core functionality and logic for all the props and prop transitions 
And not even to get started on player animation tracks 

Regardless this is yet again a fun learning experience in designing systems if never worked with before 

Like the physics conditions that changes based on what prop your using

Camera system moving in a more  cinematic motion and 
the state transitions 

Fun fun fun
